reason: B is the better proposal because selective Al transport and establishment of a slow-growing alumina scale are more physically credible and measurably testable than A’s unsupported assumption of a lattice-coherent, thermally matched SiO2/Al2O3–metal interface. B remains imperfect—its experiment does not directly measure diffusion, its dismissal of Si is overgeneralized, and some cited systems lie outside the stated regime—but it provides a clearer controlled comparison, oxidation-kinetics measurements, and falsification criterion.
